headlines: Every hit in the hideout is a bar hit (a share of a man's health bar, not a fixed HP); since the damper (v29.17) each one lands at 50 % on your men, Sarge and the heroes, the rattlesnake's swallow included.

King Croak's and his son's hits grow with the tier: × 1 · 1.1 · 1.1 · 1.2 (EASY · MEDIUM · HARD · MEGA). On MEGA the MEGA hideout rules also make every hit from his side count 2 times and every bar on his side 6 times longer; both measured on the real machines.

Bar hits a hit (EASY · MEDIUM · HARD · MEGA): the king's shot 2 · 2.2 · 2.2 · 4.8, his whole storm 3 · 3.3 · 3.3 · 7.2, the son's shot 1.7 · 1.87 · 1.87 · 4.08, a bandit 1 · 1 · 1 · 2, a sharpshooter — · 3 · 3 · 6, a lady 2 · 2 · 2 · 4, the snake's lunge — · 2 · 2 · 4; the ladies' fire 1 a beat and a stampede horse 2 on every tier, never doubled. Each lands at 50 % (the damper), then × the man's share.

Bars, one commander: King Croak 2,252 · 3,003 · 4,504 · 5,532 (the designers' time-to-kill chart on EASY · MEDIUM · HARD; the player-damage-threshold pass's table on MEGA, 3 HP under it, the × 6 landing after the rounding); the son 315 · 420 · 631 · 1,164, the brood's four on MEGA 546 each; on MEGA a lady 66, the snake 864, a bandit or a sharpshooter 18.

The lab's levels: 30 · 33 · 37 · 40. Ranks 30 to 39 carry the same bar and HP for the eleven men, so EASY, MEDIUM and HARD meet the same men (the Claymore Sarge and the six heroes gain a little HP between level 30 and 37); MEGA's level-40 stock adds the tank and leaves the grenadier home.

Since the damper no single bar hit KOs a stock man on any tier: the king's shot needs 5 to 8 in a row on EASY to HARD and 3 or 4 on MEGA; on MEGA his whole storm needs 2 (the commando 3) and the Sarge irons 3 (the Saber 4, the Claymore 7), a sharpshooter round 2 or 3.

The rattlesnake's swallow is built to KO (it carries his bar left + 1, × 2 on MEGA), but the damper halves it too: on MEGA it still KOs anyone; on MEDIUM and HARD a fresh man stands it and 3 or 4 in a row KO a stock man (measured: a fresh level-33 flame on MEDIUM took 3.2 of his 6 bar hits and stood).

units.name: THE BANDIT
units.note: the posse; the outlaws rush out at every gate (85 %, 60 %, 40 %, 20 %) and the pour brings more while he stands

attacks.name: ROUND
attacks.cadence: a man within 270 px, every 1.4 s; 52 % of his rounds go wild (a miss)
attacks.note: 1 bar hit, the same on EASY, MEDIUM and HARD; × 2 on MEGA (the MEGA hideout rules). It lands at 50 % under the damper since v29.17: the number in the table.

attacks.name: AIMED ROUND
attacks.cadence: a man within 404 px: aims 1.4 s, fires every 5.2 s
attacks.note: MEDIUM up; 3 bar hits, × 2 on MEGA (the MEGA hideout rules). It lands at 50 % under the damper since v29.17: the number in the table.

units.name: THE LADY OF THE HIDEOUT
units.note: at 75 % of his bar; her round lights a fire at the man's feet

attacks.name: FLAMESTRIKE ROUND
attacks.cadence: a man within 480 px: aims 1 s, fires every 3 s, and lights a fire at his feet
attacks.note: 2 bar hits, × 2 on MEGA (the MEGA hideout rules). It lands at 50 % under the damper since v29.17: the number in the table.

attacks.name: A BEAT OF FIRE
attacks.cadence: the patch burns 5 s, 56 px round: 1 bar hit a beat every 0.5 s to every man in it (it burns his side too)
attacks.note: never doubled on MEGA (the fire belongs to nobody). It lands at 50 % under the damper since v29.17: the number in the table.
attacks.code: fsTick → tanHit (fire9) · FS_R · FS_LIFE · FS_TICK · FS_FF

units.name: THE GIANT RATTLESNAKE
units.note: MEDIUM up, at 50 % of his bar; erupts mid-street

attacks.name: LUNGE
attacks.cadence: erupts mid-street, then surfaces and dives (burrows every 12.2 s): every man within 170 px takes the lunge and a 26 px shove
attacks.note: MEDIUM up; 2 bar hits, × 2 on MEGA (the MEGA hideout rules). It lands at 50 % under the damper since v29.17: the number in the table.

attacks.name: SWALLOW
attacks.cadence: 35 % of lunges swallow the found man whole
attacks.note: built to KO: it carries his bar left + 1 bar hits (× 2 on MEGA, the MEGA hideout rules) through the same door as every hit, so since the damper it lands at 50 % × his share: on MEGA it still KOs anyone; on MEDIUM and HARD a fresh man stands it and 3 or 4 in a row KO a stock man (measured: a fresh level-33 flame on MEDIUM took 3.2 of his 6 bar hits and stood). The game's code never swallows the Sarge; the landed page does not say so
attacks.code: updateFoeSnake → tanHit · SNAKE_EAT_P (the duel's own hash; m.type !== sarge) · pipN = gritCap − hits + 1 · dmpX

units.name: THE STAMPEDE
units.note: a hazard, not a body: 7 horses on the fight's own clock (the first at 5 s, then every 25 s), nobody's side, cannot be fought

attacks.name: TRAMPLE
attacks.cadence: 7 horses gallop east to west at 330 px/s every 25 s (the first at 5 s, "STAMPEDE!" 1.5 s before), a lane ±64 px: once a herd to every man a horse touches (52 px), a 26 px shove
attacks.note: 2 bar hits on every tier, never doubled; it tramples his outlaws too (6 HP each; the kings are spared). It lands at 50 % under the damper since v29.17: the number in the table.

units.name: JANE
units.note: your side: she rides in 40 s into the fight once King Croak is hurt (his bar below full), on MEDIUM, HARD and MEGA, never on EASY, and not when the commander is Jane herself; her rounds hit the outlaws (× 0.2 on the rattlesnake), never your men; her own bar and HP at the lab's level are her row in men

units.name: LITTLE KING CROAK
units.note: his son, at 30 % of his father's bar, with a bar of his own that rides the chart's rows with his father's (315 · 420 · 631 · 1,164); MEGA: four more sons (THE WHOLE BROOD) at 20 %, born at 546 HP each (their own wave row keeps the dial's arithmetic: the swarm number beside his), the same hits as the first son

attacks.name: STRONG SHOT
attacks.cadence: his father's brain and clocks: the nearest man within 400 px, every 1.2 to 2.4 s
attacks.note: his father's shot × 0.85; on MEGA each son of the brood hits the same (measured). It lands at 50 % under the damper since v29.17: the number in the table.

attacks.name: THE STORM, ONE VOLLEY (×8)
attacks.cadence: 8 volleys 0.2 s apart, each one on every man in his small cone
attacks.note: his father's volley × 0.85. It lands at 50 % under the damper since v29.17: the number in the table.

attacks.name: THE WHOLE STORM
attacks.cadence: every 10 s when a man stands in his cone: the crouch, then 8 volleys
attacks.note: a man who stands all 8 volleys; reach 126 · 126 · 176 · 252 px (his father's × 0.6); on MEGA four more sons (THE WHOLE BROOD) at 20 %, each the same storm. It lands at 50 % under the damper since v29.17: the number in the table.

rows.t: A proposal (Nov 1, 2026, re-read Nov 2, 2026 with THE DAMPER), nothing in the game has changed. Since v29.17 THE DAMPER lets 50 % of every enemy hit land on your men; a KO is not dampened today, a numbered hit would be, so the number written in the game is the proposed hit over that share (or the strike is set to land in full). The game fells a man whose HP reaches 0, so a hit equal to his HP fells him and one under it leaves him standing; the three heavies are Wyatt's list; HP is each man's at the lab's level for the tier, as the page read it. A man a strike never fells today, or fells by bar hits (a Sarge with a blade up, the riot shield, the snowball bouncers), keeps that rule.
